title: Pan
description: Fields extracted from a Pan document.

pan_no.description: Permanent Account Number as displayed, usually as a series of boxes near the center top, with one digit/character per box. Extract as ASCII only.

inland_revenue_office.description: Name of the Inland Revenue Office (आन्तरिक राजस्व कार्यालय शाखा) as shown left of the prominent box, e.g. 'Lahan' or 'Kathmandu'.

taxpayer_service_office.description: Name of the Taxpayer Service Office (करदाता सेवा कार्यालय) as shown next to Inland Revenue Office, typically on the left.

vat_no.description: VAT number (if any) written in small table, extracted exactly as printed.

excise_no.description: Excise Duty number (if any) from the small table under official form headings. Extract as printed.

registration_date_bs.description: Registration (issue) date in Bikram Sambat (Bs) as printed in the right-side panel (format: YYYY/MM/DD or YYYY-MM-DD, Devanagari ok).

registration_date.description: ISO-8601 Gregorian date corresponding to registration_date_bs. Always convert YYYY/MM/DD BS to ISO yyyy-mm-dd AD using standard Nepal date conversion. Leave empty if BS date is missing or ambiguous.

business_name.description: Name of the business registered, centered in the upper details area.

taxpayer_type.description: Legal form or type of taxpayer, e.g. 'Private Limited', printed next to business name.

address.description: Business address (e.g. ward, municipality, district), as shown center/left part of the page.

business_nature.description: Primary business activities or sector, as shown in the block under address.

taxpayer_signature.description: Name of the taxpayer or their representative. Extract as printed below the left-side stamp/seal and signature row.

tax_officer_signature.description: Name/signature of tax office official (right signature area at bottom).

duties.description: List of duties to be followed by the taxpayer, each bullet or line as a separate item from the bottom boxed panel.
